standard.summary: FlexRank 在训练时每步随机采样一个活跃 rank（在指定范围内），训练出的 LoRA 可以在任意 rank 下使用而不需要重新训练。
standard.effect: 一个 checkpoint 可以在 rank=8 到 rank=64 之间自由切换。低 rank 推理快但质量略低，高 rank 质量高但推理慢。
standard.whenToUse: 需要在不同硬件/速度需求下灵活部署时。不确定最优 rank 时。
standard.avoidWhen: 追求单一 rank 下的最优质量时（固定 rank 训练通常更好）。

standard_en.summary: FlexRank samples a random active rank each step (within a given range), so the trained LoRA can be used at any rank without retraining.
standard_en.effect: One checkpoint can be switched freely between rank=8 and rank=64. Low rank infers faster with slightly lower quality; high rank gives higher quality more slowly.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need flexible deployment across different hardware or speed requirements, or when you are unsure of the best rank.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you want the best possible quality at one specific rank -- fixed-rank training is usually better there.

advanced.principle: 每步从 [flexrank_lora_rank_range_min, network_dim] 中随机采样一个 active_rank，只激活前 active_rank 个 LoRA 通道参与 forward/backward。训练完成后，checkpoint 中的任何前 k 行/列切片都是可用的 rank-k LoRA。
advanced.intervention: LoRA forward 时按 active_rank 切片 矩阵。backward 时只更新活跃通道的梯度。
advanced.expectedImpact: 多 rank 兼容的便利性代价约 5-10% 质量（相比单一最优 rank 训练）。
advanced.tradeoffs: flexrank_lora_rank_range_min 控制最小可用 rank。

advanced_en.principle: Each step randomly samples an active_rank from [flexrank_lora_rank_range_min, network_dim] and only the first active_rank LoRA channels participate in forward/backward. After training, any first-k row/column slice of the checkpoint is a usable rank-k LoRA.
advanced_en.intervention: LoRA forward slices the matrices by active_rank; backward only updates the active channels' gradients.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The convenience of multi-rank compatibility costs about 5-10% quality (versus training a single optimal rank).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: flexrank_lora_rank_range_min sets the minimum usable rank.
